Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of social and health services and the health care authority to enter into datasharing agreements with Oregon and Idaho agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to identification for health services applicants;and adding a new section to chapter 70.14 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of social and health services and the healthcare authority shall enter into datasharing agreements with theappropriate agencies in the states of Oregon and Idaho to assure thevalid Washington state residence of applicants for health care servicesin Washington. Such agreements shall include appropriate safeguardsrelated to the confidentiality of the shared information. (2) The department of social and health services and the healthcare authority must jointly report on the status of the datasharingagreements to the appropriate committees of the legislature no laterthan November 30, 2007.
